cases.issue: The same invoice charge appears to have been captured twice.
cases.request_summary: Confirm the invoice and payment references before correcting duplicate billing.

cases.issue: The customer requests a refund for an unused service order.
cases.request_summary: Delivery has not started and no non-refundable commitment is recorded.

cases.issue: The account owner changed phones and cannot receive a recovery code.
cases.request_summary: Verify ownership before changing the recovery channel or multi-factor settings.

cases.issue: Ownership evidence conflicts with the account record during recovery.
cases.request_summary: Stop recovery and move the case to specialist review because ownership evidence is missing or conflicting.

cases.issue: A service delivery failed and the customer requests a correction.
cases.request_summary: Confirm the failed outcome in the order or delivery record and document customer impact.

cases.issue: The provider outcome is unknown and the correction exceeds specialist authority.
cases.request_summary: A consequential correction needs review before the case can proceed.

cases.issue: The case file contains more customer information than the billing decision needs.
cases.request_summary: Keep only the minimum customer data required to explain and authorize the support decision.

cases.issue: A proposed customer message contains a secret and raw provider payload.
cases.request_summary: Do not copy secrets, raw provider payloads, or private reasoning into customer messages or audit records.

cases.issue: The same invoice charge appears twice.
cases.request_summary: Check the policy that applied before the current policy became effective.

cases.issue: A tenant without this corpus asks about a duplicate invoice charge.
cases.request_summary: No policy from another workspace may be returned.

cases.issue: No published policy covers this case category.
cases.request_summary: The retrieval layer must abstain without embedding the query.

cases.issue: A policy exists but does not match this product and region.
cases.request_summary: The retrieval layer must report that the policy is inapplicable.

cases.issue: The matching policy is outside its effective dates.
cases.request_summary: The retrieval layer must report stale policy evidence.

cases.issue: Two current policies claim the same billing decision scope.
cases.request_summary: The retrieval layer must abstain and surface a policy conflict.

cases.issue: The matching policy index is incomplete.
cases.request_summary: The retrieval layer must fail closed until the complete profile is ready.
